headline: Approved height exception at 3 Deacon Farm Ln. and a second story at 1000 Washington St.; continued 8 Angle St. deck request.
summary: Approved a height exception at 3 Deacon Farm Ln. by a 3-1 vote, with one member recused. Approved a second story at 1000 Washington St. by a 4-1 vote. Also approved a shed replacement at 15 Traverse St. and continued the 8 Angle St. deck request to September 24, 2026.
decisions: Approved the Chair signing the consent agenda decisions for 24R Lyndale Ave., 877 Washington St., 25 Marina Dr., and 6 Collins Ave., 5-0.
Approved the application of Seaver Properties LLC for a special permit and/or variance to exceed maximum building height at 3 Deacon Farm Ln., 3-1, with Mr. Cannavo recused.
Continued the application of R. Bartholemew M Driscoll and Heather E M Driscoll for a deck at 8 Angle St. to the September 24, 2026 meeting, 5-0.
Approved the application of Martha Leven and Peter Hornbeck for a special permit and/or variance to demolish and rebuild a shed at 15 Traverse St., 5-0.
Determined there is no increase in the non-conformity for the application of Kate and Timothy Donovan for a new entry at 73 Dolliver Neck Dr., 5-0.
Approved the application of Patricia Doherty for a special permit and/or variance to add a second story at 1000 Washington St., 4-1.

plain_text:
CITY OF GLOUCESTER 
ZONING BOARD OF APPEALS 
3 POND ROAD, GLOUCESTER MA 01930 
 
ZONING BOARD OF APPEALS 
Meeting Minutes  
 
 
  September 10, 2026 
 
 
Board Members Present: 
Joseph Parisi III, Chairman 
Lauren Norton, Vice Chair 
Michael Nimon  
Peter Cannavo  
 
Alternate Members Present: 
Ronald E. Wilson  
Axel Ruiz- Absent 
 
Also in Attendance: 
Natasha Dale, Clerk 
 
The Chair introduces the Members and reads from the Open Meeting Law. 
 
Consent Agenda: 
 
Ms. Norton moves the approval of the Chair to sign the following decisions. 
a. 24R Lyndale Ave. 
b. 877 Washington St. 
c. 25 Marina Dr. 
d. 6 Collins Ave. 
Mr. Nimon seconds 
All in favor, 5-0 
 
Continued Applications: 
Application of Seaver Properties LLC seeking a special permit and/ or variance to 
exceed maximum building height at 3 Deacon Farm Ln., Map 109A, Lot 91 in the R-10 
zoning district.
Sal Frontiero, 46 Middle St.,Gloucester is present representing his clients Saver 
Properties LLC. 
Mr. Parisi states that the board is only looking into the height exception. The board did 
receive a sun study from Mr. Frontiero. 
The study showed 30 and 33 feet during the morning, noon and 3 PM during the 
summer and winter solstice. 
The sun study proved that there is no major overshadowing. 
The chair opens public testimony. 
Speaking in favor: none 
Speaking in opposition: 
Bill Salmonfink, 8 Seeall St. 
Erica Everett, 8 Seeall St. 
Keith Waters, 6 Deacon Farm Ln. 
John Dionne, 1 Deacon Farm Ln. 
JD Curley, 8 Deacon Farm Ln. 
Rebuttal: 
Mr. Frontiero states that the additional 3 feet does not add that much to the shadowing 
over other buildings. 
The chair closes public testimony. 
Discussion By the Board: 
Mr. Nimon states that he did not see any other properties on Deacon Farm Lane were 
above 30 feet. He states it does not fit the neighborhood character.  
Mr. Nimon states that it is already a very large structure and we are allowing it to be 
even larger with the approval of this special permit.  
Ms. Norton moves to approve the application of Seaver Properties LLC seeking a special 
permit and/ or variance to exceed maximum building height at 3 Deacon Farm Ln., 
Map 109A, Lot 91 in the R-10 zoning district.  
Mr. Wilson seconds
In Favor: 3 
In Opposition 1 
Mr. Cannavo recused himself from the vote.  
Application of R. Bartholemew M Driscoll and Heather E M Driscoll seeking a special 
permit and/ or variance to construct a deck at 8 Angle St., Map 2, Lot 37 in the R-5 
zoning district.   
Ms. Norton moves to continue the application of R. Bartholemew M Driscoll and 
Heather E M Driscoll seeking a special permit and/ or variance to construct a deck at 8 
Angle St., Map 2, Lot 37 in the R-5 zoning district to the September 24, 2026 meeting.   
Mr. Nimon seconds 
All in favor, 5-0 
New Applications: 
 
Application of Martha Leven and Peter Hornbeck seeking a special permit and/ or 
variance to demolish and rebuild a shed at 15 Traverse St., Map 57, Lot 41 in the R -10 
zoning district.  
 
Deb Eliason, 470 Washington St., Gloucester is present representing her clients. 
 
The applicants are seeking a special permit to demolish, reconstruct and alter a pre -
existing non-conforming shed on a non-conforming lot in the same location with a slightly 
increased height by a little over a foot. The shed must be replaced because it is structurally 
unsound.   
 
No new non- conformities are created with the new project and will meet the current 
building code.  
 
The chair opens public testimony. 
 
Speaking in favor: none 
Speaking in opposition: 
Judith Sennett, 17 Traverse St., Gloucester 
 
The chair closes public testimony.  
 
Rebuttal:
Ms. Eliason reminds the board that what is in front of them a project for the shed not the 
ongoing project in the main property and any issues the neighbors or board have should 
be directed to the contractor.  
 
Mr. Nimon moves to approve the a pplication of Martha Lev en and Peter Hornbeck 
seeking a special permit and/ or variance to demolish and rebuild a shed at 15 Traverse 
St., Map 57, Lot 41 in the R-10 zoning district.  
 
Mr. Wilson seconds 
All in favor, 5-0 
 
Application of Kate and Timothy Donovan seeking a special permit and/ or variance to 
construct a new entry at 73 Dolliver Neck Dr., Map 202, Lot 17 in the R-20 zoning district.  
 
Deb Eliason, 470 Washington St., Gloucester is present representing her clients. 
 
Ms. Eliason is first requesting the board to make a determination that a special permit is 
not required because there is no increase in the non-conformity.  
 
The applicants are seeking to modify their front entry way to their home. It is unsafe and 
there is no way to put hand rails on or block it off. There will be no changes to the footprint 
or the foundation line. The square footage of the house will remain the same.  
 
The property is partially in the VE zone and partially in the AE zone, but since t here are 
no changed to lot coverage, no relief is required from the floodplain ordinance.  
 
There is no way to raise the door without adding a gable. 
 
Ms. Norton moves to determine that there is no increase in the non -conformity in the 
Application of Kate and Timothy Donovan seeking a special permit and/ or variance to 
construct a new entry at 73 Dolliver Neck Dr., Map 202, Lot 17 in the R-20 zoning district. 
 
Mr. Nimon seconds 
All in favor, 5-0 
 
Application of Patricia Doherty seeking a special permit and/ or variance to add a second 
story at 1000 Washington St., Map 140, Lot 19 in the R-20 zoning district. 
 
Horace Turner, 23 Essex Ave., Gloucester is present representing his client Patricia 
Doherty.
Mr. Turner states that his clients are planning to increase the size of their house by adding 
a second floor. There will be no increase to the footprint of the house.  
 
Two cantilever decks will be coming off of the second floor would be the only thing 
expanding. 
 
The applicants are looking for a special permit to alter and expand by putting on a second 
floor. 
 
The chair opens public testimony. 
 
Speaking in favor: none 
Speaking in opposition:  
Emily Matthews, 1001 Washington St., Gloucester 
Larry Bullock, 996 Washington St., Gloucester 
 
The chair closes public testimony. 
 
Ms. Norton moves to approve the application of Patricia Doherty seeking a special permit 
and/ or variance to add a second story at 1000 Washington St., Map 140, Lot 19 in the R-
20 zoning district. 
 
Mr. Cannavo seconds 
In favor, 4 
In opposition, 1 (Mr. Wilson) 
 
Adjournment: 
Ms. Norton moves to adjourn at 8:44 PM 
Mr. Cannavo seconds 
All in favor, 5-0
